name: Concurrent deliveries of the same bank event are credited once
title: SC-13-09-06 Concurrent deliveries of the same bank event are credited once
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F5
When two deliveries of the same bank transaction ID and amount 1675.00 race for "A-3"
Then one payment and one receipt exist and allocations total 1675.00
And "A-3" has zero debt and zero advance
